pages.title: Fluid pipeline
pages.text: Fluid pipes are similar to cables, but can only be used to transport fluids. Right-click the fluid pipe with a wrench to switch the transmission mode: "None", "Normal", "Cocurrent" and "Split".
"Split" pipes remove fluid from the network, while "cocurrent" pipes incorporate fluid into the network.
Similar to electrical cables, fluid ducts also have an integral block in the form of a wall that is used to safely transport fluids and keep the structure sealed.
